title: A finite closed family with geometrically irreducible generic traces stays so near the generic point
statement: Let $p:P\to T$ be a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$, and let $I$ be a finite type indexing closed subsets $C_i\subseteq P$. Suppose for each $i$, every field $E$ and every $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$, the inverse image of $C_i$ under the geometric fibre inclusion $P_\eta\times_{\kappa(\eta)}\operatorname{Spec}E\to P$ is irreducible and nonempty [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There is an open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$ such that the corresponding inverse image of every $C_i$ is irreducible and nonempty for every $t\in U$, every field $E$ and every $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$. No cover identity or intersection condition is assumed or concluded. Empty $I$ is allowed.

proof.text: The generic point makes T irreducible. Replace T by its reduction, base-change P and the closed subsets, and give each pulled-back subset its reduced closed subscheme structure. Reduction is a universal homeomorphism after field base change and so preserves the geometric subset tests. Closed immersions are finite type and quasi-compact; their composition with p is finite type. The given generic inverse-image condition is geometric irreducibility of each closed scheme generic fibre.

Apply the second proof of Tag 0559 separately to each reduced closed scheme: Stacks Proposition 29.28.1 makes a reduced finite type scheme over the integral base flat and finitely presented after shrinking. Choose a nonempty affine open and use Tag 054X to make it fibrewise dense, including after field extension. Choose a finite purely inseparable extension making the function field separably generated. If a generator b has b^q=a/d over the base fraction field, replace b by db, whose q-th power is a*d^(q-1) in the base ring. The subalgebra generated by these scaled generators is finite integral and radicial, hence its spectrum is a universal homeomorphism. Reduce the pulled-back closed scheme and apply Proposition 29.28.1 again to restore flatness and finite presentation. A separating transcendence basis gives a birational absolutely irreducible hypersurface. Clear coefficients and denominators to spread the common affine open, and use Tag 054X to make it fibrewise dense.

For the hypersurface apply Tag 0557: substitute sufficiently separated powers of the last variable into the other variables to give distinct monomials distinct highest exponents in the last variable. Invert the nonzero leading coefficient to make the polynomial monic. For each pair of positive monic factor degrees summing to its degree, bound the degrees in all other variables by those of the polynomial and impose the coefficient relations for a factorization in a finite type coefficient algebra. Absolute irreducibility says this algebra has no point over the algebraic closure of the generic field, so Nullstellensatz makes its generic localization zero. A nonzero base element kills its unit. Invert the product of the finitely many such elements. No nontrivial factorization can occur over any residue field extension. Geometric irreducibility of the hypersurface fibres and fibrewise density transfer the conclusion to the original closed scheme. Shrink to the open image of its flat finitely presented map to retain nonemptiness.

Each of the resulting nonempty opens contains eta. Their finite intersection contains eta and gives the required U. Transfer it through the reduction homeomorphism. The geometric fibres of the induced closed schemes embed with images exactly the inverse images of C_i, which proves the stated tests. For empty I use the whole base.

theorem exists_open_closed_family_geometric_fibre_shrink {P T : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : P ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (C : I → Set P) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (C i))
    (hgeom : ∀ i, ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E)
      (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField η))),
      IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (p.fiberToSpecResidueField η) z ≫
        p.fiberι η) ⁻¹' C i)) :
    ∃ U : T.Opens, η ∈ U ∧ ∀ i t, t ∈ U →
      ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E)
        (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField t))),
        IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) z ≫
          p.fiberι t) ⁻¹' C i)
